notes.value: Forthing Friday BEV, the all-electric version of Dongfeng Forthing's Friday SUV, sold by Capital Smart Motors. Per the Capital Smart Motors brochure: 64.4 kWh LFP battery, front permanent-magnet motor with 150 kW and 340 Nm, front-wheel drive, 500 km CLTC; AC Type 2 in about 7 hours (0–100%) and DC CCS2 30–80% in 30 minutes, with a 3.3 kW portable charger and a camping mode. 0–100 km/h about 8 s and 170 km/h per PakNEV, which estimates about 351 km in real-world use. 4,600 × 1,860 × 1,680 mm on a 2,715 mm wheelbase, 180 mm ground clearance, 480 L boot, 1,820 kg, 19-inch wheels on 235/55 R19 with a full-size spare, 500 mm wading depth, McPherson front and multi-link rear suspension. Two trims: BEV Luxury PKR 8,999,000 and BEV Exclusive PKR 10,499,000; the Exclusive adds the driver-assistance suite, 360° camera and premium materials. Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 100,000 km, battery 8 years / 120,000 km (Capital Smart Motors). Sources: Capital Smart Motors brochure and website, PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: Forthing Friday REEV, the range-extended version of Dongfeng Forthing's Friday SUV, sold by Capital Smart Motors: a 1.5-litre (1,498 cc) petrol engine only generates electricity, and the wheels are driven by the electric motor. Per the Capital Smart Motors brochure: 31.94 kWh LFP battery, rear permanent-magnet motor with 120 kW and 240 Nm, rear-wheel drive, about 220 km electric and about 1,150 km combined (CLTC) from a 43 L tank; AC Type 2 in about 5.5 hours and DC CCS2 30–80% in 30 minutes (40 kW per PakNEV), 3.3 kW portable charger, camping mode. 0–100 km/h 10.9 s, 170 km/h. 4,600 × 1,860 × 1,680 mm on a 2,715 mm wheelbase, 180 mm ground clearance, 480 L boot, 1,820 kg, 19-inch wheels on 235/55 R19 with a full-size spare. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a 360° camera, adaptive cruise control, AEB, lane keeping, LED matrix headlights, dual HD screens, dual-zone climate control, wireless charging and an electric panoramic sunroof. PKR 9,999,000 (REEV Exclusive). Warranty: vehicle 5 years / 100,000 km, battery 8 years / 120,000 km (Capital Smart Motors). PakNEV lists this car as front-wheel drive with 204 hp, which are the BEV's figures; the brochure is followed here. Sources: Capital Smart Motors brochure and website, PakNEV, PakWheels.
